title: Narrow truthful Final Ready control-only governance HOLD without Product PASS

why5.question: Why does an admitted Governance-only PR remain NOT_READY?
why5.answer: Final Ready currently accepts HOLD_NOT_RUN only for the five-file Sprint3 administrative closure, although strict no-Product governance-only changes also cannot truthfully run Product CI.

why5.question: Why not treat Product CI exit code zero as PASS?
why5.answer: The true product:ci output is HOLD and implementation_enabled=false; changing it to PASS would violate Test Integrity and Product truth.

why5.question: How can the exception be safe?
why5.answer: A single new exact approved GOVERNANCE_REFORM dossier, immutable product HOLD state, exact dossier digest and strictly governance-only changed paths must all hold before accepting CONTROL_GATES_PASS_PRODUCT_NOT_RUN.

why5.question: What else remains required?
why5.answer: Six exact HEAD/BASE log-bound local evidence receipts, four real required PR checks, independent BCE, ordered Human Final Ready, and manual Human provenance still remain mandatory; non-Product PASS is never upgraded.

why5.question: Does this address provider time-of-merge expiry?
why5.answer: No. Only GitHub ruleset/required provider enforcement could do that; the existing checks alone cannot automatically detect TTL crossing. This scoped candidate does not claim protected 16P E2E.

alternatives: Broaden Product HOLD for all PRs (prohibited)
Exact Human-approved governance-only HOLD conditional local/BCE attestations, no Product PASS (chosen)
no_change: Governance-only PR cannot meet normal Final Ready without fake Product PASS or a new precise control-only policy.
rollback: Revert only after an equivalent fail-closed policy exists; retain all Product gates, Human Final Ready, and protected GitHub requirements.
negative_tests: Unapproved, replay-shape, expired and wrong BASE/digest rejects
No active Sprint/Task or Product implementation may be silently reactivated
Human Final Ready and required four PR statuses stay mandatory

scope_exception.reason: Permit truthful Product HOLD_NOT_RUN reporting for an exact approved governance-only change without accepting Product PASS or other waiver.
scope_exception.risk: A generalized Product HOLD waiver could let Product work bypass CI; allow only exact Human dossier, exact governance paths and no active Sprint/implementation.
scope_exception.follow_up: Test synthetic positive/negative matrix, obtain exact BASE/HEAD/digest Human approval, run four real required GitHub gates and independent BCE. Do not auto-Merge.

carry_forward.justification: This PR adds no Product acceptance claim, deferral, Task, Build Spec, or Sprint lifecycle modification; #407 and 16P protected E2E gaps remain explicitly open.

notes: Only implementation and synthetic negative tests of a governance Final Ready control state; no Main changes, no production execution, no forbidden Product PASS. Candidate exact source digest computed using self-tested SHA256. Corrected initial escaped regex SyntaxError detected by real GitHub fast-loop; adjusted governance-only path patterns without widening accepted paths. Exact digest rebound; Human approval still null.
